story_title: Join and Respond to Waiting List

acceptance_criteria.text: Given an event has reached its registration capacity and registration is open, when an Attendee views it, then they can join the waiting list instead of registering.
An Attendee cannot join the waiting list for an event they are already registered or waitlisted for.
The Attendee can view their position on the waiting list.
The Attendee can leave the waiting list, after which those behind them move up.
Given a place becomes available, when the waiting list is not empty, then the place is offered to the first Attendee on the list (first in, first out) and that Attendee is notified.
The Attendee can accept the offer within 3 days, after which they are registered and removed from the waiting list.
Given the Attendee declines the offer or does not respond within 3 days, when the offer ends, then the place is offered to the next Attendee on the list.
A place under offer is not available for direct registration by other Attendees.
The assigned Event Coordinator can override the order and offer a place to a chosen waitlisted Attendee.
No new offer is made once the event has started, and an outstanding offer ends when the event starts even if 3 days have not passed.

open_questions: RESOLVED 2026-10-23 (agreed by the team, all recommendations followed): Data - four nullable columns on registrations (waitlisted_at, offered_at, offer_expires_at, offer_ended_reason), migration 20261023120000_add_waiting_list_offers. A waiting registration is 'waitlisted'; a place is under offer while offer_expires_at is set.

RESOLVED 2026-10-23: A place is free when registered + under offer < capacity. Free places go to the earliest to join (first in, first out, #26) whenever one comes free - an attendee withdraws, someone holding an offer leaves, an offer is declined or lapses, the capacity is raised or registration turned back on. Lapsed offers end like SPM-82's holds: no scheduled job, on reading events and registrations and on the unread count.
RESOLVED 2026-10-23: Declining, or letting an offer lapse after 3 days (#44), takes the attendee off the list (status Withdrawn) and the place goes to the next; they may join again at the back.

RESOLVED 2026-10-23: When the event starts, an outstanding offer ends (an offer made less than 3 days before the start ends at the start) and the attendee keeps their position; no offer is made after the start (AC10, #116), nor while the event isn't Confirmed.

RESOLVED 2026-10-23: The coordinator's override (AC9) moves a place under offer - the offer made last - to a chosen waiting attendee, with a fresh 3 days; the one it was offered to keeps their position; both are notified. Never beyond the capacity: with no place under offer there is nothing to give.

RESOLVED 2026-10-23: Joining needs the event full and its registration period open (AC1). While anyone is waiting, a newcomer joins the list rather than registering past them (AC8). Offers continue after registration closes, until the event starts.

DECIDED 2026-10-23: Wording - 'Join waiting list', 'You're on the waiting list.', 'You're number N on the waiting list.', 'Leave waiting list' ('Leave the waiting list for <title>?' / 'Stay on the list'), 'A place is available for you' / 'Accept it by <date>. If you don't, it goes to the next person on the waiting list.' with 'Accept place' and 'Decline' ('Decline this place?' / 'Decline place' / 'Keep the offer'); My Registrations 'Number N in the queue' / 'Place offered - accept by <date>'; Attendees tab 'Place offered until <date>' and 'Offer place' ('Offer the place to <name>?' / 'Not now'). Notifications 'A place is available' and 'Your offer has ended'.
RESOLVED 2026-10-23: Not in this story - notifying anyone but the attendee (e.g. the coordinator when an offer lapses), and email; notifications are in-app (SPM-53).
